# mutation-testing-elements report schema

`mutation-testing-report-schema-3.9.0.json` is an unmodified copy of
`packages/report-schema/src/mutation-testing-report-schema.json` from
[stryker-mutator/mutation-testing-elements](https://github.com/stryker-mutator/mutation-testing-elements)
at tag `v3.9.0`, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 by the Stryker Mutator team.

It is here only so `tests/MutationTestingReport.Tests.ps1` can validate what PSMutant writes
against the format's own definition. It is not part of the published module. Replace it with a
newer release's copy, renamed to that version, when the format moves on.
